घृषु: घृषु घृषु, i. e. ved. घृष् = कृष् + उ, adj. Brisk, Chr. 291, 12 = Rigv. i. 64, 12.
घृष्वि: घृष्वि घृष्वि, i. e. ved. घृष् = हृष् + वि, adj. Brisk, Chr. 291, 1 = Rigv i. 85, 1.
घोटक: घोटक घोटक, m. A horse, Pañc. 254, 23.
घोणा: घोणा घोणा (a dialectical form of घ्राणा), f.  1. The nose. Mṛcch. 35, 10.  2. The nostrils of a horse, MBh. 6, 3390.  3. A beak, MBh. 10, 38.
घोण्टा: घोण्टा घोण्टा, f. The betel-nut tree, Suśr. 2, 103, 16.
घोर: घोर घोर,  I. adj., f. रा।  1. Horrible, dreadful, Rām. 3, 8, 12.  2. Violent, Suśr. 1, 35, 7.  II. m.  1. A name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10375.  2. A proper name, MBh. 13, 4148.  III. n. A horrible act, Rām. 1, 58, 8.  -- Comp. सु-, adj. terrific, hideous. -- Cf. probably Goth. gaurs, sad.
घोरत्व: घोरत्व घोर + त्व, n. Horribleness, MBh. 3, 13781.
घोष: घोष घोष, i. e. घुष् + अ, m.  1. Sound, Man. 7, 225; roar, Rām. 2, 66, 10; language, Rām. 3, 52, 20.  2. A station of herdsmen, MBh. 2, 215.  3. A name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10386.  -- Comp. दम-, m. a proper name, MBh. 1, 7029. नन्-दि-, m. shout, MBh. 13, 5288. महा-, n. a market. सिंह-, m. a proper name, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 20. सुख-पुण्याह-, i. e. सुख-पुण्य-अह-, m. the proclamation of a happy holiday. स्त्री-, m. day-break.
घोषक: घोषक घोषक, i. e. घुष् + अक, m. A bell-man, Kathās. 24, 60.
घोषण: घोषण घोषण, i. e. घुष् + अन,  I. adj. Causing to sound, Bhāg. P. 4, 5, 6.  II. n., and f. णा, Proclaiming, Rām. 5, 58, 18; Daśak. in Chr. 183, 5.
घोषवत्: घोषवन्त् घोष + वन्त्,  I. adj. वती, Sounding, MBh. 2, 65; roaring, MBh. 6, 578.  II. f. वती, A kind of lute (?), Kathās. 12, 32.
घोषवन्त्: घोषवन्त् घोष + वन्त्,  I. adj. वती, Sounding, MBh. 2, 65; roaring, MBh. 6, 578.  II. f. वती, A kind of lute (?), Kathās. 12, 32.
घोषिन्: घोषिन् घोषिन्, i. e. घोष + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Sounding, MBh. 5, 3348.
घ्न: ऽघ्न -घ्न, i. e. हन् + अ, Latter part of comp. adj. and 8., f. नी (ना, MBh. 13, 2397),  1. Striking, Man. 8, 386.  2. Killing, a murderer, Man. 9, 232.  3. Destroying, Man. 8, 127; Rām. 2, 35, 6.  4. Removing, Man. 7, 218.
घ्रा: घ्रा घ्रा, i. 1, जिघ्र (ep. ii. 2, घ्राति, MBh. 14, 668), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 7982).  1. To smell, Man. 2, 98.  2. To sniff at, Rām. 2, 26, 35.  3. To perceive, Bhāg. P. 1, 3, 36.  4. To kiss (or, rather, To smell as a token of affection; see Wilson, Hindu Dr. vol. i. p. 45 n.), MBh. 9, 2940. Anomalous ptcple. of the pres. जिघ्रा-ण, MBh. 1, 5781. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. घ्रात, also in the sense of an act, Having scented. Ptcple. of the fut. pass.  1. घ्रातव्य, n. Smell, Bhartṛ. 1, 7.  2. घ्रेय, n. Smell, MBh. 2, 200.  Comp. अ-, adj. unfit to be smelt, Man, 11, 67. Anomalous absolut. जिघृत्वा, Hariv. 7059. -- With the prep. अव अव,  1. To smell, Man. 3, 218.  2. To kiss, Rām. 2, 20, 21. -- With आ आ,  1. To smell, Man. 11, 149.  2. To kiss, Rām. 2, 70, 16. -- Ptcple. of the pf. pass. आघ्रात, in active sense, Hariv. 4478. --With उपा उप-आ,  1. To smell, MBh. 3, 14504.  2. To kiss, Rām. 1, 4, 9. -- With समुपा सम्-उप-आ, To kiss, Rām. 2, 72, 4. -- With समा सम्-आ,  1. To smell, Rām. 5, 23, 32.  2. To kiss, Rām. 2, 72, 4. -- With उप उप,  1. To smell, MBh. 5, 4059; to smell at, Man. 4, 209.  2. To kiss, Rām. 2, 72, 30. -- With समुप सम्-उप, To kiss, Rām. 4, 22, 1. -- With परि परि, To kiss all over, MBh. 11, 616. -- With वि वि,  1. To trace, Bhāg. P. 3, 13, 28.  2. To smell, Bhāg. P. 3. 2, 18. -- Cf. βρῶμος and ध्रान; perhaps also Lat. frāgro.
घ्राण: घ्राण घ्राण, i. e. घ्रा + न,  I. m.  1. Smelling, Bhāg. P. 2, 1, 29.  II. n. and f. णा, The nose, MBh. 1, 6074. --Cf. ῥῑ́ν, ῥῑ́ς.
घ्राणज: घ्राणज घ्राण-ज, adj. Produced by the nose, Bhāṣāp. 51.
घ्राति: घ्राति घ्रा + ति, f. Smelling, Man. 11, 67 (68).
घ्रातृ: घ्रातृ घ्रा-तृ, m. One who smells, MBh. 14, 619.
